_comment: Historical Linux-versus-Windows 0.3.4 feasibility study, superseded by linux-package-size-analysis-0.3.6.json. Its further ZIP/XZ ideas are not current TODOs. Source XPIs were read with CRC/SHA checks; this historical study made no packaging changes.

rejected_blanket_strip_debug.reason: GNU strip shrank the BOLT CPython first PT_LOAD file range from 0x1000 to 0x588; DT_STRTAB still starts at offset/address +0x588, making interpreter startup fail.

projections._comment: Measured payload-size candidates, not built or accepted XPI artifacts. New installer code, markers and alias recipes add small unmeasured bytes. Raw savings describe archived payload, not expanded alias copies. Savings across codec/strip cases must not be added twice.

retention_policy.reason: One-click offline installation must not require a separately installed host interpreter. The tested CPython executable is incompatible with blanket GNU strip.

retention_policy.component: wheel-owned native libraries and required Python modules
retention_policy.reason: Keep loader paths, ABI, imports and all current dependency functionality; Linux OpenCV DT_NEEDED libraries are not individually removable.

retention_policy.component: DocLayout ONNX model and o200k_base vocabulary
retention_policy.reason: Preserve byte-identical layout inference and tokenization without downloads; these are not local DeepSeek translation weights.

retention_policy.component: licenses, METADATA, WHEEL and package discovery data
retention_policy.reason: License compliance and runtime distribution discovery still apply; tiny repeated metadata is not the primary size target.

retention_policy.component: TLS, font, XML, PDF, cache and shaping capabilities
retention_policy.reason: Required for current translation-provider, PDF/font and persistence behavior; independent font files are not shipped in these four XPI artifacts.

scope._comment: These flags describe this independent research task, not unrelated parallel workspace edits. Source snapshots may differ; the four measured release XPI hashes must remain unchanged.

source_input_changes_during_analysis._comment: Read-only observation of concurrent source edits, not changes made by this task; archive inventories remain pinned to the four original 0.3.4 hashes.
